title: I built a football tycoon with Claude and Codex and it’s finally out on Android
author: No_Dentist_7426
selftext:
After months of working on it, Hometown FC is finally on Google Play.

It’s a football tycoon where you own a club, invest in the town around it and build a family that can eventually take over. I wanted the career to feel personal: the academy player you brought through gets older, your children grow up, and the place you started in changes over the years.

The game is built with React Native and Expo. Claude Code and Codex have been heavily involved in implementation, debugging and testing, alongside AI-generated artwork.

The biggest lesson has been how much work sits between a feature working once and a game holding together over a long career. Transfers affect wages, wages affect finances, town investment affects the club and all of that has to survive saving, loading and season changes.

The workflow has involved scoped changes, code reviews, automated tests and long season simulations, followed by checks on actual phones. Native purchases meant that passing tests and working correctly on a device are separate things.

The attached video mixes game captures with two labelled AI time-lapses of the town and stadium. The later stages use a prepared example career with extra resources to show the progression. The trailer music was also AI-generated.

Android is live now. The iPhone version is still waiting for Apple review. It’s free to download, with ads and optional purchases that can affect resources or progression.

[Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.hometownfc)

Happy to talk about the development process. For anyone else building a management game with AI, how are you testing what happens ten or twenty seasons into a save?
